Docs.summary: A that produces Azure credentials ( instances) from an . It dispatches on the CredentialSource value of the supplied section and recognizes the full set of Azure token-based credential sources (e.g. AzureCliCredential, ManagedIdentityCredential, EnvironmentCredential, WorkloadIdentityCredential, ChainedTokenCredential, etc.). API-key sections (CredentialSource: ApiKeyCredential) are intentionally NOT claimed by this resolver — consuming clients that accept an API key are expected to dispatch on Credential.CredentialSource themselves at construction time and read Credential.Key directly.
Docs.remarks:
Register this resolver explicitly via (or its host-builder overload), or rely on
and friends, which transparently append a built-in instance to the resolver chain. The class has a public parameterless constructor so it can be used with AddCredentialResolver<AzureCredentialResolver>().
